objective: Construct and independently accept operational software from original public requirements, then assess whether it supports a credible complete-cost route toward US$3 billion trailing-365-day profit.
scope: A finite computational production test and separate conditional economic requirements model; no physical deployment, real customer consent, financing or native commercial account.

K1.role: Exposed development; actual original-client acceptance before K2 policy construction.
K1.limits: Conventional max-flow and local improvement; no novelty, human-expert superiority or physical warehouse savings inferred.

K2.release_rule: Only current cumulative confirmed orders, public customers/directed duration matrix, current departure and own prior state. No future confirmation rows or hidden expert/reference solutions.
K2.source_exposure: Public benchmark, not globally unseen or externally blinded; constructor authors instructed not to inspect future-table data. Shared-host API/process/audit-hook restrictions are narrower than adversarial OS isolation.

primary_metric: Full acceptance by the untouched source verifier after all 18 original submissions are irreversibly locked. Any missing/unknown/duplicate/not-ready order, illegal route, capacity/time-window/depot violation or wrong envelope fails the complete delivery.
secondary_metrics: Original mean directed driving seconds across three days; smaller is better conditional on full acceptance.
Actual process/child CPU and wall time, route feasibility/objective check counts and budget stops.
Actual retained K1 primitive call path versus independently constructed ordinary policy.
Resource/cost, available reach and financing requirements for the separate frozen economic scenarios.
decision: If only one policy meets full client acceptance, retain the accepted construction within its source contract. If both qualify, compare original objective and measured resources; retain the stronger complete ordinary route if it wins. A computational advantage alone does not establish learned discovery, human productivity or a newly economical industry.
material_effect: Complete acceptance is mandatory before any modeled offer. Travel-time differences are exact original-source outcomes, not independent dollar savings. No arbitrary percentage improvement establishes business success; fee, support and alternative-cost evidence must adjudicate material commercial value.
equal_information: Both arms get original public requirements, public-source client semantics, all substantive K1 facts and executable primitives, the same rolling windows/access rights and 50,000 full route checks per round. Each may construct its own competent conventional route method. Different method-generated observation histories and internal state are allowed. No paid models are called in the policy; actual included-agent construction costs/token billing remain unknown and generation attempts are recorded.
baseline: A competent conventional rolling latest-safe policy with multistart insertion, directed 2-opt and route relocation/swap, including exact feasibility and own history. It may use retained primitives and conventional software and is not restricted to singleton routes or a handicapped controller.
retention: A real included agent generated K1 executable code from observations/fixtures and its full source was retained. A separate included agent constructs K2 code using permitted K1 evidence and public K2 contract, before any original K2 outcomes. This is actual included-agent software construction, followed by deterministic frozen policy execution—not an unattended Python model generator, mock discovery or model weight editing.
ablation_and_claim_limits: Ordinary equal-content use is the procedure-removal comparison. No human-only construction-time experiment is performed, all model/host bills are unknown, and the two independently authored programs may differ beyond retention. Report a narrower program comparison rather than attribute all difference to outlearning. An actual retained primitive call establishes reuse, not causal necessity.
leakage: Do not access hidden expert/reference answers or invoke ORSim/model-powered integration. Broker release is chronological and source unchanged. Originals remain visible only to the broker/final verifier; no candidate correction after final outcome. Original public inputs and their authored benchmark conditions remain distinguished from actual operations.
economics: Exactly the three prewritten ECONOMIC_PROTOCOL.json regions are evaluated after acceptance/resource facts. Prices/quotes/budgets/costs/collection and funding schedules are independent authored scenarios. Actual reach, capacity and current money must be supported independently; missing values remain UNESTABLISHED. Never book research projections as revenue. No new financial ledger or native account is operated in this capability cycle; previous073 money is not pooled.

target.metric: Exact trailing365 complete modeled cost profit from one independently audited native account, using connected_enterprise.scale.trailing_profit at a fixed endpoint. This study has no such operating account.

stopping: Complete the fixed 18-period original stream once for each frozen method. Preserve every original output and error. No post-outcome policy repair or world replacement counted as the same test. A genuine interrupted uncommitted period preserves STARTED/ERROR and stops automatic retry. Replaying completed locked outputs is verification, not new confirmation.
uncertainty: Three chronological days from one public source task are not independent sites or a calibrated market sample. Report exact acceptance/objective and resource differences with applicability and unknown costs, not population probabilities or spurious confidence intervals.
qualification: Source and protocol frozen and published before original K2 execution. Independent post-run audit replays source bytes and every locked original submission, without tuning policies or reading private account authority.
permissions: Public sanitized code/compact evidence/draftPR only. No action-time formal approval, merge, release or deployment inferred from the profit objective.
